notice: Second frozen holdout, authored after holdout v3 exposed a defect (a bare digit inside an identifier satisfied the temporal answer-shape rule). These eight cases were written after that fix and had never been executed when they were written. They are run once; the result is reported as-is. Holdout v3's own first-run score (11/12) remains on the record in docs/final_qualification/acceptance_matrix.md, and the fix it motivated is disclosed there.
corpusNote: 14 synthetic documents, invented for this project. Nothing here is real policy.
